title: First environment audit of the loop
body:
## Goal
Measure the loop environment once and report findings: the layout of `execution/` and `policy/`, which roles and profiles exist, and what the trusted startup budget and params look like.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Audit report lists the roles under `execution/roles` and `policy/roles` with their profiles.
- [ ] Audit report states the startup budget status from `.session/startup.json` (currently unmeasured).
- [ ] Findings are reported only; no files under `execution/` or `policy/` are changed.
## Verification
`test -s audit/latest.md || test -s .session/report.md`
## Context
- link: policy/params.yml, policy/profiles.yml, execution/profiles.yml: current parameters and profiles to measure
- link: .session/startup.json: unmeasured budget notice to report on
## Budget
- policy/ and execution/ read-only; the goal (src/greeting.txt, src/farewell.txt) is not part of this task

title: Write src/greeting.txt
body:
## Goal
Create the file `src/greeting.txt` containing the single line `hello from perpetua`. Write only this file. Report, do not add anything else.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` exists and its only line is `hello from perpetua`
- [ ] no other file is created or changed
## Verification
`grep -qx "hello from perpetua" src/greeting.txt && [ "$(wc -l < src/greeting.txt)" -eq 1 ]`
## Context
- goal: the goal text in `.session/loop-state.json` (`goal.text`)
## Budget
- `src/greeting.txt` (new file)
